title: 10x Fantasi Bar Juice | 50/50 Shortfill Bundle
description:
Fantasi Bar Juice 50/50 E-Liquid Bundle Pack:
If you’re a big fan of our award winning Fantasi nicotine salts, you’ll be happy to see we have bundled together the Bar Juice shortfill collection for one single price!
These 50/50 shortfills by Fantasi are flavour-packed with candy, fruit, iced, and minty notes to put inside your pod kits!
Tropical Punch Ice: Icy cocktail of succulent tropical fruits!
Strawberry Ice Cream: Sweet, thick and creamy strawberry ice cream!
Spearmint Ice: Sweetly refreshing spearmint flavor !
Red Grape Ice: Rich, hand-picked red grapes blasted with ice!
Lemon Peach Passion Fruit Ice:Enticing mash-up of exotic summer fruits!
Gummy Bear Ice: Experience all your favorite gummy bear flavor !
NRG Ice: Dripping with classic energy drink flavor
Blue Bubblegum Ice:Sticky-sweet explosion of fruity bubblegum!
Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice: Tantalising trio of summer berries
Mad Blue: Delicious mix of candied berries
Vape juice is made with a 50/50 mix(70% VG to 30% PG). As this is a balanced vape juice, you will need a lower-powered device to vaporize it, like a pod device or vape starter kit. Our Ferocious Flavours Vape Liquids are available in a variety of quantities and intensities.
120ml Shortfill Bottles of 0mg 70/30 vape juice are available. If you want to add nicotine to your Shortfills, we have 100ml and 120ml bottles available with 3mg and 6mg nicotine strengths. We have 3mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg in stock, so you can just pop it into your tank and start vaping right away!
Ingredients:
Vegetable Glycerine (50%)
Propylene Glycol (50%)
Vapoholic Flavouring
Nicotine Free, Freebase Nicotine, Or Nicotine Salts
What’s in the Bundle?
1x Tropical Punch Ice Shortfill
1x Strawberry Ice Cream Shortfill
1x Spearmint Ice Shortfill
1x Red Grape Ice Shortfill
1x Lemon Peach Passion Fruit Ice Shortfill
1x Gummy Bear Ice Shortfill
1x NRG Ice Shortfill
1x Blueberry Bubblegum Ice Shortfill
1x Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Ice Shortfill
1x Mad Blue Shortfill
Specifications:
Ratio
50/50
Size
100ml, 120ml
Nicotine Type
Freebase Nicotine, Salt Nicotine
Nicotine Strength
0mg – No Nicotine, 3mg, 6mg
Highlights:
10 double flavor concentrated shortfills for one price!
50/50 ratio for optimal flavour and throat hit
Highly popular disposable vape flavors!
Perfect for pod and starter kit vapers
